protocol.status: Exploratory simulation protocol fixed before this sweep; not preregistered
protocol.seed_formula: 1001 + 104729 * repetition_index, index=0..29; same seed across controllers and observers
protocol.primary_outcome: fall by 10 s; true tilt reaches 45 deg at a control endpoint
protocol.recovery: Final dwell >=1 s within 1 deg tilt, 0.03 m position and 0.03 m/s speed, evaluated from truth
protocol.gain_policy: Original controller gains frozen; within-controller sensing comparison, not a fair-tuned controller-class ranking
protocol.sensor_scope: Independent Gaussian angle and gyro noise per sample; ideal position/velocity channels; whole packet delayed; no accelerometer physics, bias, quantisation or dropout
protocol.delay_policy: Initial noisy packet at t=0 is available at startup and held until the first newer delayed packet; filter processes each packet once; no prediction to current time
